scenes.narration: On July 7th, 1881, the steamer Proteus sailed from St. John's, Newfoundland, and turned north toward Greenland. On board was Lieutenant Adolphus Greely's expedition.

claims.text: The Proteus sailed from St. John's on 7 July 1881, heading toward Greenland
The expedition was led by Lieutenant A. W. Greely

scenes.narration: On August 11th, she anchored in Discovery Harbor, on Lady Franklin Bay. Eight days later, the Proteus left. Twenty-five men stayed behind.

claims.text: The Proteus anchored in Discovery Harbor, Lady Franklin Bay, on 11 August 1881
The Proteus left her anchorage on the morning of 19 August 1881

scenes.narration: A relief ship was sent in 1882. The Neptune never reached them.

claims.text: The 1882 relief expedition, the Neptune, did not reach Lady Franklin Bay

scenes.narration: In 1883, a second relief expedition went north on the Proteus. On July 23rd, she was crushed in the pack ice and sank.

claims.text: The 1883 relief expedition sailed on the Proteus
The Proteus was crushed in the pack and sank on 23 July 1883

scenes.narration: On June 22nd, 1884, the ships Thetis and Bear found seven men alive near Cape Sabine. Seventeen had starved, and one had drowned. Only six came home.

claims.text: Thetis and Bear rescued seven survivors near Cape Sabine on 22 June 1884
Seventeen of the twenty-five died of starvation and one drowned
Six survivors returned; Sergeant Elison died at Godhavn on 8 July 1884
